workshoptitle: Build Connected Energy & Utilities Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Build Connected Energy & Utilities Solutions with Oracle AI Database
tutorials.description: Meet Seer Utility Network and follow its service-request story and data model.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect service risk, service requests, semantic matches, and service coverage.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a customer application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Risk Search
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly built semantic search with an in-database embedding model for utility services and risk notices.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate an Operational Event Network
tutorials.description: Follow restoration events, shared asset records, and multi-hop paths with SQL/PGQ and Graph Studio.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Customers to the Closest Field Logistics Site
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial to compare service points, territories, and field logistics sites.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Service Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a service demand-surge model inside Oracle Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Energy & Utilities Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language utilities questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build an Energy & Utilities Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a utilities query agent with an approved SQL tool and inspect its calls.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
